senses.gloss:
रौद्र a. (द्रा-द्री f.) [रुद्र-अण्]
1
‘Rudra-like’, violent, irascible,
wrathful.
--2 Fierce, savage,
terrible, wild.
--3 Addressed to Rudra
(as a hymn).
--4 Bringing
misfortune, calamitous.
--द्रः
1 A
worshipper of Rudra.
--2 Heat, ardour,
warmth, passion, wrath.
--3 The
sentiment of wrath or furiousness;
see S. D. 232 or K. P. 4.
--4 N. of
Yama,
--5 Winter.
--द्रं
1 Wrath,
[]
rage.
--2 Formidableness, fierceness,
savageness.
--3 Heat, warmth; solar
heat.
--Comp.
--कर्मन् a. doing
dreadful acts. (--n.) a terrible
magic rite.
--दर्शन a. frightful-looking,
terrific.
